newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen shares end down ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end down ahead of weekend.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices closed down on Friday, fuelled by caution ahead of the weekend when some companies are likely to report their 1997 interim results, brokers said.
The hard currency B share index dipped 1.32 points or 0.99 percent to 131.27 points on turnover of HK$31 million against Thursday's HK$34 million.
The Chinese yuan-based A share index declined 2.30 points or 0.56 percent to 408.12 on turnover of 5.8 billion yuan, compared with 5.2 billion on Thursday.
